"""Tests for the todo app (store + cli)."""

import pytest

from cli import main
from store import TodoStore


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path):
    return TodoStore(str(tmp_path / "todos.json"))


class FakeStore:
    """Minimal stand-in so CLI tests don't touch disk."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.todos = []
        self._next_id = 1

    def add(self, text):
        todo = {"id": self._next_id, "text": text, "done": False}
        self.todos.append(todo)
        self._next_id += 1
        return todo["id"]

    def list(self, include_done=True):
        if include_done:
            return list(self.todos)
        return [t for t in self.todos if not t["done"]]

    def complete(self, todo_id):
        for todo in self.todos:
            if todo["id"] == todo_id:
                todo["done"] = True
                return True
        return False

    def remove(self, todo_id):
        for i, todo in enumerate(self.todos):
            if todo["id"] == todo_id:
                del self.todos[i]
                return True
        return False


def test_add_returns_incrementing_ids(store):
    assert store.add("first") == 1
    assert store.add("second") == 2
    assert store.add("third") == 3


def test_list_hides_done_items(store):
    store.add("open one")
    done_id = store.add("done one")
    store.add("open two")
    store.complete(done_id)
    texts = [t["text"] for t in store.list(include_done=False)]
    assert texts == ["open one", "open two"]


def test_list_all_shows_done_with_x_prefix(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    fake.add("buy milk")
    fake.add("walk dog")
    assert main(["done", "1"], fake) == 0
    capsys.readouterr()  # drain "done #1"
    rc = main(["list", "--all"], fake)
    assert rc == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
    assert out == ["x #1 buy milk", "#2 walk dog"]


def test_list_open_only(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    fake.add("buy milk")
    fake.add("walk dog")
    assert main(["done", "1"], fake) == 0
    capsys.readouterr()  # drain "done #1"
    rc = main(["list"], fake)
    assert rc == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
    assert out == ["#2 walk dog"]


def test_complete_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    assert store.complete(99) is False


def test_remove_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    assert store.remove(99) is False


def test_ids_not_reused_after_removal(store):
    store.add("a")
    store.add("b")
    store.add("c")
    assert store.remove(2) is True
    new_id = store.add("d")
    assert new_id == 4


def test_ids_not_reused_across_instances(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todos.json")
    s1 = TodoStore(path)
    s1.add("a")
    s1.add("b")
    assert s1.remove(1) is True
    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    assert s2.add("c") == 3


def test_persistence_across_instances(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todos.json")
    s1 = TodoStore(path)
    s1.add("a")
    s1.complete(1)
    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    assert [t["text"] for t in s2.list(include_done=False)] == []
    assert [t["text"] for t in s2.list(include_done=True)] == ["a"]
    assert s2.list(include_done=True)[0]["done"] is True


def test_cli_add_prints_added(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    rc = main(["add", "buy", "milk"], fake)
    assert rc == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "added #1\n"


def test_cli_done_missing_id_stderr_and_exit_1(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    rc = main(["done", "42"], fake)
    assert rc == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"


def test_cli_rm_missing_id_stderr_and_exit_1(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    rc = main(["rm", "42"], fake)
    assert rc == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"


def test_cli_unknown_subcommand_exit_2(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    rc = main(["frobnicate"], fake)
    assert rc == 2
    assert "usage" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_cli_missing_subcommand_exit_2(capsys):
    fake = FakeStore()
    rc = main([], fake)
    assert rc == 2
    assert "usage" in capsys.readouterr().err

"""Command-line interface for the todo app.

Usage:
    todo add <text...>
    todo list [--all]
    todo done <id>
    todo rm <id>
"""

import sys

from store import TodoStore

USAGE = "usage: todo <add <text...> | list [--all] | done <id> | rm <id>>"


def main(argv, store):
    """Run the CLI with the given argv (without the program name).

    Returns an int exit code: 0 on success, 1 for a missing todo id,
    2 for usage errors.
    """
    if not argv:
        print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    cmd = argv[0]

    if cmd == "add":
        if len(argv) < 2:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        todo_id = store.add(" ".join(argv[1:]))
        print(f"added #{todo_id}")
        return 0

    if cmd == "list":
        include_all = "--all" in argv[1:]
        for todo in store.list(include_done=include_all):
            if todo["done"]:
                print(f"x #{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
            else:
                print(f"#{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
        return 0

    if cmd in ("done", "rm"):
        if len(argv) < 2:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        try:
            todo_id = int(argv[1])
        except ValueError:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        if cmd == "done":
            ok = store.complete(todo_id)
            message = f"done #{todo_id}"
        else:
            ok = store.remove(todo_id)
            message = f"removed #{todo_id}"
        if ok:
            print(message)
            return 0
        print("no such todo", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    store = TodoStore("todos.json")
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:], store))

"""Command-line interface for the todo app.

Usage:
    python cli.py add <text...>
    python cli.py list [--all]
    python cli.py done <id>
    python cli.py rm <id>
"""

import sys

USAGE = "usage: cli.py {add <text...> | list [--all] | done <id> | rm <id>}"


def main(argv, store):
    """Run the CLI with the given argv (without the program name).

    Returns an int exit code: 0 on success, 1 for a missing todo id,
    2 for an unknown or missing subcommand.
    """
    if not argv:
        print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    cmd, rest = argv[0], argv[1:]

    if cmd == "add":
        if not rest:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        todo_id = store.add(" ".join(rest))
        print(f"added #{todo_id}")
        return 0

    if cmd == "list":
        if rest and rest[0] == "--all":
            for todo in store.list(include_done=True):
                prefix = "x " if todo["done"] else ""
                print(f"{prefix}#{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
        elif rest:
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        else:
            for todo in store.list(include_done=False):
                print(f"#{todo['id']} {todo['text']}")
        return 0

    if cmd in ("done", "rm"):
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        todo_id = int(rest[0])
        ok = store.complete(todo_id) if cmd == "done" else store.remove(todo_id)
        if not ok:
            print("no such todo", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"{'done' if cmd == 'done' else 'removed'} #{todo_id}")
        return 0

    print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from store import TodoStore

    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:], TodoStore("todos.json")))

"""Tests for the todo CLI (store.py + cli.py)."""

import pytest

from cli import main
from store import TodoStore


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path):
    return TodoStore(str(tmp_path / "todos.json"))


def test_add_returns_incrementing_ids(store):
    assert store.add("first") == 1
    assert store.add("second") == 2
    assert store.add("third") == 3


def test_list_hides_done_items(store):
    store.add("open one")
    done_id = store.add("done one")
    store.add("open two")
    store.complete(done_id)

    open_todos = store.list(include_done=False)
    assert [t["id"] for t in open_todos] == [1, 3]
    assert [t["text"] for t in open_todos] == ["open one", "open two"]


def test_list_cli_hides_done_items(store, capsys):
    store.add("open one")
    done_id = store.add("done one")
    store.complete(done_id)

    assert main(["list"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "#1 open one\n"


def test_list_all_cli_shows_done_with_x_prefix(store, capsys):
    store.add("buy milk")
    store.add("walk dog")
    store.complete(1)

    assert main(["list", "--all"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "x #1 buy milk\n#2 walk dog\n"


def test_complete_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    store.add("something")
    assert store.complete(99) is False


def test_remove_missing_id_returns_false(store):
    store.add("something")
    assert store.remove(99) is False


def test_ids_not_reused_after_removal(store):
    store.add("one")
    store.add("two")
    store.add("three")
    assert store.remove(2) is True
    new_id = store.add("four")
    assert new_id == 4
    assert [t["id"] for t in store.list()] == [1, 3, 4]


def test_ids_not_reused_across_store_instances(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todos.json")
    s1 = TodoStore(path)
    s1.add("one")
    s1.add("two")
    s1.remove(1)

    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    assert s2.add("three") == 3


def test_persistence_across_instances(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todos.json")
    s1 = TodoStore(path)
    s1.add("persisted")
    s1.complete(1)

    s2 = TodoStore(path)
    todos = s2.list(include_done=True)
    assert [t["id"] for t in todos] == [1]
    assert todos[0]["done"] is True


def test_cli_add_prints_added_id(store, capsys):
    assert main(["add", "buy", "milk"], store) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out == "added #1\n"


def test_cli_done_success_and_missing(store, capsys):
    store.add("task")
    assert main(["done", "1"], store) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "done #1\n"

    assert main(["done", "42"], store) == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"


def test_cli_rm_success_and_missing(store, capsys):
    store.add("task")
    assert main(["rm", "1"], store) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "removed #1\n"

    assert main(["rm", "1"], store) == 1
    err = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert err == "no such todo\n"


def test_cli_unknown_or_missing_subcommand(store, capsys):
    assert main([], store) == 2
    assert capsys.readouterr().err.startswith("usage:")

    assert main(["frobnicate"], store) == 2
    assert capsys.readouterr().err.startswith("usage:")
